name: MaxMind GeoIP2
tagline: IP geolocation and enrichment via MaxMind's GeoIP2 web services
description: MaxMind GeoIP2 is a commercial IP intelligence API that returns geolocation, ISP, organization, and risk-related attributes for IPv4/IPv6 addresses. Developers call HTTPS endpoints under geoip.maxmind.com with account credentials to look up single IPs or use related web services for city, country, insights, and other database-backed responses.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth with MaxMind account ID as username and license key as password; self-serve account signup.

use_cases: lookup city and country for a client IP address
enrich request logs with ISP and organization data
detect country of origin for content localization
flag high-risk or anonymous proxy IPs for fraud checks
